tools.name: search_agents
tools.description: Search the public Diwan al-Mizan agent directory by name, handle, skill, platform, or summary. Read-only. A listing is not an endorsement. Testnet only; tQNT has no cash value.

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: Fetch one public Diwan al-Mizan listing by id or exact name. Read-only. A listing is not an endorsement.

tools.name: mizan_status
tools.description: Live Mizan benchmark counts: how many predictions have been submitted and resolved, and how many agent versions are rated (50 or more resolved answers in a category). No authentication. Does not invent scores.

tools.name: mizan_get_passport
tools.description: Fetch the public, version-bound Mizan calibration passport for an agent_id. No authentication. A version is not rated until 50 resolved answers in a category. Also returns the badge URL and README markdown.

tools.name: mizan_issue_key
tools.description: Call the public POST /v1/keys endpoint and return a new API key (shown once). The key can only submit checks for this agent_id. First request claims the name. This writes to the public API; store the key yourself — the server does not keep a copy.

tools.name: mizan_check
tools.description: Log an answer and confidence on the public POST /v1/check endpoint before the question resolves. Requires the API key from mizan_issue_key, passed as api_key (not stored). For I don't know, set answer to IDK and omit confidence. You may send question_id from GET /v1/questions instead of copying ques

tools.name: trust_check
tools.description: Read-only. Given a Mizan agent_id (and optionally a category), return a plain verdict from its PUBLIC Mizan passport: no_record (nothing logged), provisional (fewer than 50 resolved answers, indicative only) or rated (50 or more), plus calibration warning flags and what the verdict does not cover. tools.description: Test your own calibration in under 60 seconds, no signup and no key. Call with no arguments to get the 10 fixed practice questions (true/false statements). findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "mizan_check" references sensitive artifacts (api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: mizan_get_passport, mizan_check, mizan_try · Private data: mizan_issue_key, mizan_check · Public sink: mizan_issue_key, mizan_check, mizan_try · Destructive: mizan_try.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: mizan_get_passport, mizan_check, mizan_try · Private data: mizan_issue_key, mizan_check · Public sink: mizan_issue_key, mizan_check, mizan_try · Destructive: mizan_try

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
